name: cliamp
author: Jan Renz
description: A window for cliamp, the terminal music player: radio, podcasts, public-broadcaster catalogues and your queue, with cliamp's own spectrum in the bar. Starts cliamp headless when it is not already running, so the bar works whether or not a terminal player is open. Needs cliamp on PATH and nothing else.

barWidget.description: Now playing with cliamp's spectrum; click opens the library window.
